items.title: 9.7 Yaksan electric field mein charged zarron ki harkat (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 9.7 with Fig. 9.17 (PDF 205-206).

blocks.text: Do mukhalif charged mutawazi dhaati plates apne darmiyan yaksan electric field banati hain, jis ki simt musbat se manfi plate ki taraf hai. Field mein rakha musbat charge +q field ki simt mein chalta hai, jabke manfi charge -q us ke ulat. Charge q par lagne wali electric force ki miqdar (Fig. 9.17) F = qE ... (9.26) hai, jahan E yaksan field ki electric intensity hai. Agar plates ke darmiyan potential difference V aur un ka faasla d ho to E = V/d ... (9.27).

Yaksan electric field ka charged zarron ki harkat par asar samajhne ke liye dono plates ke darmiyan rakha ek electron lein. Electron us par lagne wali force F ki wajah se musbat plate ki taraf tez hota (accelerate) hai. Maan lein V = 20 V aur d = 2.0 cm = 2 x 10^-2 m; to E = V/d = 20 V/(2 x 10^-2 m) = 1000 N C^-1. Electron ka acceleration F = ma se: a = F/m = qE/m. q = e = 1.6 x 10^-19 C aur m = 9.1 x 10^-31 kg ke saath a = (1.6 x 10^-19 C x 1000 N C^-1)/(9.1 x 10^-31 kg) = 1.76 x 10^14 m s^-2.

Agar electron manfi plate se chhora jaye to musbat plate tak pohanch kar hasil hone wali velocity harkat ki teesri equation 2aS = vf^2 - vi^2 se milti hai, jahan S = d = 2 x 10^-2 m, vi = 0 aur vf = v: 2 x 1.76 x 10^14 m s^-2 x 2 x 10^-2 m = v^2, to v^2 = 7.04 x 10^12 m^2 s^-2 (print mein das ki taqat ke baghair) aur v = 2.65 x 10^6 m s^-1.

blocks.caption: Plates ke darmiyan electron (V = 20 V, d = 2.0 cm)

blocks.prompt: Ek electron yaksan field E = 300 N C^-1 mein vi = 2.99 x 10^6 m s^-1 se dakhil hota hai; plates 10.0 cm lambi hain. Us ka acceleration aur field se guzarne ka waqt nikalein (numerical 9.5).
blocks.explanation: a = eE/m = 1.6 x 10^-19 x 300/9.1 x 10^-31 = 5.27 x 10^13 m s^-2 (E ke ulat, isi liye print mein manfi alamat). Ufuqi velocity nahi badalti, to t = 0.100/2.99 x 10^6 = 3.34 x 10^-8 s.

items: Mukhalif charged plates ke darmiyan field yaksan, + se -; musbat charges E ke saath, manfi us ke khilaf chalte hain. F = qE (9.26), E = V/d (9.27), a = qE/m.
2.0 cm par 20 V: E = 1000 N C^-1, a = 1.76 x 10^14 m s^-2, aur aaram se chala electron musbat plate tak 2.65 x 10^6 m s^-1 par pohanchta hai.
